STIMMYZ · DESIGN REFERENCE

Mint logo + GIPHY picker

The approved glossy mint “Stimmyz ✦” logo is now used directly, including the original sparkle. The compact logo sits on a dark plaque for readability in every theme. GIPHY artwork selection is preserved: demo search results in Customize, not a live API integration.

Interaction contract
Quick Add is always position #1 and defaults to Record device audio. It has no arrow outside Edit Board. Pad ⋮ appears only during Edit Board. Each board independently supports Pages or Scroll. Library ⋮ is always available. Sound boost and looping are per-clip. The three-tab navigation stays unchanged. GIPHY is online-only, with a local fallback icon.

SCREEN CHECKLIST

All buttons, menus, theme switches, and sample GIPHY search results are interactive. Actual GIPHY requests, licensing permission, audio processing, and media files are not included.

The sample pad thumbnails are crops from AI-generated concept artwork, included for design comparison only. Do not distribute them in a released app without checking the relevant rights.
